description:
This is a bug CR for defect ticket:

## System Behaviour

Not all set conditions for PVis FZDs are restricted to PWF >= Wohnen (ie Wohnen, Fahrbereitschaft herstellen/beenden, Fahren, Hint: Not PAD)

Notes:
- This could lead to erroneous FZDs.
- New ticket for issue for 26-03.

## Technical Details

Changes are required in:
- Status of Video Watch Dog Event / Fieldueberwachung
- Status of Video Watch Dog Signalueberwachung
- pvisRenderingControl.PVisAvailability Event / Fieldueberwachung and Signalueberwachung
- pvisRenderingControl.pvisStatus.degradation Signalueberwachung
- parkingUserInteractionControl.parkmenuPrimaryDisplayAlive Signalueberwachung
- StatusTrailer Event/Fieldueberwachung

The required correction is that not all set conditions for PVis FZDs are restricted to PWF >= Wohnen, and the affected scopes must correctly include Wohnen, FahrbereitschaftHerstellen, Fahren, and FahrbereitschaftBeenden where required. For the Video Watch Dog related logic, the relevant conditions include velocity below 36 km/h, IDCEvo startup timeout, and the valid PWF scope. NetworkMonitoringControl must also be enabled for the corresponding SI.

software_requirements.text: The system shall fulfill the PVis VideoWatchdog technical-error condition only when vehicle velocity is below 36 km/h, the IDCEvo startup-time condition is active, the valid PWF scope is Wohnen, FahrbereitschaftHerstellen, Fahren, or FahrbereitschaftBeenden, and NetworkMonitoringControl is enabled for the corresponding SI.
The system shall treat the Wohnen, FahrbereitschaftHerstellen, Fahren, and FahrbereitschaftBeenden scope as fulfilled only when pwfState remains in one of those states for at least 3 seconds.
